verdict.rationale: NVIDIA Project G-Assist is documented as a built-in AI assistant on GeForce RTX PCs that can 'tune, control, and optimize your system,' which is a form of task delegation, but it's scoped narrowly to system/GPU settings rather than general-purpose task delegation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of G-Assist's capabilities, detail on the scope of tasks it can perform, and confirmation it ships broadly rather than as a limited beta feature.
